info.name: Analyst Reports Raw Text Analyst Insights earnings API

params.name: page
params.description: Page offset. For optimization, performance and technical reasons, page offsets are limited from 0 - 100000. Limit the query results by other parameters such as date

params.name: parameters[date]
params.description: Date to query for calendar data. Shorthand for date_from and date_to if they are the same. Defaults for latest

params.name: parameters[date_from]
params.description: Date to query from point in time

params.name: parameters[date_to]
params.description: Date to query to point in time

params.name: parameters[date_sort]
params.description: Field sort option for earnings calendar. Apply `:desc`, `:asc` for sort order

params.name: parameters[importance]
params.description: The importance level to filter by. Uses Greater Than or Equal To the importance indicated

params.name: parameters[tickers]
params.description: One or more ticker symbols separated by a comma. Maximum 50 tickers

params.name: parameters[updated]
params.description: Records last Updated Unix timestamp (UTC). This will force the sort order to be Greater Than or Equal to the timestamp indicated

items.docs: Returns earnings data for a selected period and/or security. Includes actual EPS and revenue figures, estimates, surprises, and historical comparisons. Earnings data is crucial for investors to assess company performance.
